entities.summary: David Humiston Kelley was an American archaeologist and epigrapher. He was associated with the University of Nebraska-Lincoln, and later with the University of Calgary. He is most noted for his work on the phonetic analysis and major contributions toward the decipherment of the writing system used by the Maya civilization of pre-Columbian Mesoamerica, the Maya script. David H. Kelley was a architects & engineers from Albany (1924-04-01, Albany–2011-05-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
